narrative.overview:
docs.holdworks.ai is a workbench that the reader's AI executes while the human approves. Every page pairs reference with a copy-ready action: a command, a prompt or a request. The look is the documentation category's canon: white ground, slate ink, one Holdprint blue, slate hairlines. Light and dark themes are equal citizens.

Density is calm and reference-grade. Depth comes from 1px hairlines and tonal steps; the only dark objects are the code panels. Confirmed rejections: no marketing hero on the docs home, no single endless scrolling page, no gradients, no glass.
keyCharacteristics: One accent (Holdprint blue) on a slate neutral ramp; other hues only carry meaning.
Hairline borders and tonal fills define structure; shadows exist only on overlays.
Inter for prose and UI, JetBrains Mono for literals.
Every page ends in an action: copy buttons and page-level Copiar para a IA / Markdown.
A signature interaction: the plugin map.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Blue is the only brand color. Other hues appear only as method, caution or pending semantics, never as decoration.

rules.name: The Dark Code Rule
rules.body: Code panels are dark slate in light and dark themes alike.

rules.name: The Pending Marker Rule
rules.body: An undecided value renders as an amber dashed monospace chip with a help cursor, never as an invented host.

rules.name: The Literal Is Mono Rule
rules.body: Anything a reader or an AI will paste, type or match is set in JetBrains Mono. Everything else is Inter.

rules.name: The No Uppercase Rule
rules.body: Labels are sentence case at a small size and heavier weight; no uppercase or letter-spaced micro-label style.

rules.name: The Flat Page Rule
rules.body: Page content never carries a shadow. A shadow means this floats above the page.

dos: Do pair every concept with a copy-ready action: a code figure, a prompt figure or both, each with a copy button.
Do use only the tokens above. Blue (#2563eb) is the sole accent, and slate carries everything else.
Do set literals in JetBrains Mono, and everything else in Inter at 400 to 720.
Do build structure with 1px hairlines and Ground/Subtle/Muted steps.
Do keep code panels dark slate in both themes and make light and dark equally finished.
Do render undecided production URLs as amber dashed pending chips.
Do use the 120ms transition with the cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1) ease, and honor prefers-reduced-motion.
Do keep keyboard focus visible (2px accent outline, 2px offset).
donts: Don't put a marketing hero, gradient headline or fake chat demo on the docs home.
Don't put one endless scrolling page in place of addressable per-topic pages.
Don't use gradients, glass or blur, or shadows on page content.
Don't add a second accent hue or decorative color.
Don't theme the code panel to light.
Don't use uppercase or letter-spaced micro-labels above headings.
Don't use emoji or glyph icons; icons are the inline stroke SVG set.
Don't invent hosts, ports, accounts or keys in examples; use a placeholder chip.
